findings.title: Phase 6b re-seeds a DOLA amount baked from forge's local pass. When the mined minter execute delivers more, the excess collateral silently stays on the OWNER EOA and :verify passes. When it delivers less (e.g. an SYA claim mid-session), noMintDeposit reverts and the session halts with ~14.6k DOLA of phUSD collateral on the EOA and DOLA minting disabled
findings.severityRationale: No loss of funds: OWNER is trusted custody, and the resume path re-derives R on chain and converges (fork-proven). The silent excess is cents to ~1 DOLA per realistic session, or larger only if a DOLA mint lands mid-session (none in 30 days). The revert branch is loud, on an attended path, and recoverable in one resume leg (memory: fail-loud-is-a-feature). Kept above QA because a story-092 AC ('no DOLA is left on OWNER') and the halt-point NatSpec claim ('a local-pass R that differs from the mined one cannot strand or over-deposit') are demonstrably false on the uninterrupted path, and the post-broadcast verifier cannot detect it. Borderline Medium only if the halt compounds with OBS-35-04 (window lapse) or the stale ETH budget (L-10).
storyRefs: story-092 (Technical Details step 5: 'Assert OWNER's DOLA balance is back to its level before execution, so no DOLA is left on OWNER'; Resume hazard)
findings.description: Under `--broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger`, forge runs the whole script in a local EVM at session start and then signs the recorded calldata one tx at a time. In Phase 6b, `_minterExecuteWithdrawal` computes R = OWNER DOLA delta in that local pass. `_minterReseedSdola` then emits `DOLA.approve(minter, r)` (L1138) and `minter.noMintDeposit(sdolaStrategy, DOLA, r)` (L1139) with r as a literal. On chain, the execute (tx #43 of 67) redeems pro-rata of the LIVE autoDOLA shares at the LIVE price, minutes to hours later. The two post-checks `_doneMinterReseeded` and `balanceOf(OWNER) == ownerDolaBeforeExec` (L1142) run only in the local pass. The verifier's `_doneMinterReseeded` lower-bounds the minter's sDOLA principal against the recorded (local) R, and nothing re-checks OWNER's residual DOLA. The resume path re-derives R from chain correctly; the first uninterrupted run does not.
findings.impact: (a) R_mined > R_sim, the default: autoDOLA's price accretes continuously. Minter collateral that backs outstanding phUSD is left on the OWNER EOA instead of the sDOLA strategy. The AC is violated and :verify is green, so nobody is told. (b) R_mined < R_sim: an SYA.claim (permissionless for NFT holders; ~every 5 days, and made more attractive mid-session because Phase 6's V1 relinquish adds ~27 DOLA of skimmable surplus), a Tokemak valuation down-step, or anything else that removes minter surplus between session start and tx #43. noMintDeposit reverts. The operator is left with 14.59k DOLA of phUSD collateral on a hot Ledger EOA, DOLA minting disabled, and a dangling ~14.6k DOLA approval to the minter. They must re-run the session, which again requires the full 0.00792 ETH budget, while the 78h window and the V2 pause (Phase 7 not reached) keep running.
findings.evidence: Verified on anvil fork of 25990689 (side-effects.json UE-35-01/02). CLEAN broadcast: run-latest tx #47/#48 args carry 14633137717790185615971; the mined execute Transfer to OWNER = 14633140027218540037484; OWNER DOLA after = 2309428354421513 wei; :verify exit 0 (fork-logs/07-cutover-run-latest.json, 09-verify-clean.log). INJECTED run (fork-logs/inject-driver.sh; claim-equivalent skimSurplus mined in the same block as setStablecoinEnabled(false), 39.284 DOLA): tx #48 noMintDeposit status 0, 'SafeMath: subtraction underflow'. Halted: OWNER DOLA 14593854548308164103700, minter DOLA enabled=false, registration 0x1760, allowance 14633137717790185615971 (fork-logs/12-*). Resume: 'NOTE: recorded R differs ... re-seeding the live delta', converges; verify exit 0 (13-*, 14-*). Plausibility: fork-logs/sya-rewardscollected-30d.tsv (5 claims in 30 days); autoDOLA convertToAssets samples show continuous accretion plus a ~0.5 bps step.
findings.recommendation:
Do not sign an amount derived from a state that an earlier signed tx changes. Either option below works:
(1) End the first broadcast leg immediately after the execute: the script stops after `_minterExecuteWithdrawal` when not resuming, e.g. a `PHASE6B_EXECUTE_ONLY` gate or a deliberate `return` once `minterExecRecorded` was freshly set. The operator re-runs `:broadcast`, whose local pass then reads the mined R. This reuses the resume path that is already fork-proven.
(2) Re-seed a deliberately conservative amount, then sweep the remainder in the resume/verify leg.
In both cases, add to `VerifyStableStakerV2Cutover._verifyPhase6b_minterMove`:
- `DOLA.balanceOf(OWNER) == minterMove.ownerDolaBeforeExec`
- a check of the minter's sDOLA principal against the actual `WithdrawalExecuted` / DOLA Transfer amount read from logs, not against the recorded local-pass R.
Correct the halt-point (b) NatSpec (L167), which currently asserts the first-run path cannot strand DOLA.

findings.title: CUTOVER_GAS_BUDGET is still the 46-tx story-087 value (22M), but the story-091/092 session is 67 txs using 22.98M gas; its own sizing rule now needs 25.16M, so the 20% preflight margin is 95% consumed and ~2 additional USDe stakers before broadcast would halt the run mid-Phase 6 with the preflight having said OK
findings.severityRationale: Incomplete fix signal on L-07 d6896c6e (fixed 84e2324): the preflight mechanism works (fork: refuses at the live balance) but its constant was not re-derived after stories 091 (CREATE 3.1M + 4 txs) and 092 (~17 txs). Funding the wallet is a knowing owner action, but the operator is told ETH_BUDGET|OK by a check whose premise ('46 transactions', '#37 USDe migrate 3,383,096' largest late limit) is stale, which is a non-obvious footgun (Law 3). The halt is resumable and nothing is lost, but it lands mid-Phase 6 (V1 paused, V2 paused) and inside the minter window. Low, not Medium: it needs staker growth or gas-limit variance above 4.7%.
storyRefs: story-092 (adds txs without re-deriving the budget)
findings.description: `CUTOVER_GAS_BUDGET = 22_000_000` (L421) is documented as 18,317,077 used + 3,383,096 largest late gas limit (#37 USDe migrate), from the audit-33 46-tx rehearsal. The package.json `//stable-staker-v2-cutover:broadcast` comment repeats '46 transactions'. At 7ac6e70 the session is 67 transactions: Phase 3b adds a 3,106,997-gas CREATE plus 3 txs, and Phase 6b adds 17 txs including the 559,036-gas execute. `_requiredOwnerEth` = 22M x price x 1.2 = 26.4M gas-equivalent.
findings.impact:
An anvil broadcast with OWNER funded to exactly the required 0.00792 ETH @ 0.3 gwei completed, but:
- total gasUsed was 22,982,701, already above the 'budget'
- the binding upfront check, cumulative-used-before + signed limit, peaks at 25,163,101 on tx #41 (USDe migrate, signed limit 6,706,846), leaving 1,236,899 gas (4.7%) of the 20% margin
- each extra USDe staker adds roughly 0.38M used / 0.77M limit to tx #41, so about two new V1 USDe stakers (V1 stays open until Phase 1), or limit variance, make the node reject tx #41 or #42+ with -32003 insufficient funds
The run then halts mid-Phase 6 with V1 and V2 both paused, possibly with some pools migrated, inside the minter window. The operator trusted ETH_BUDGET|OK. The resume also demands the full 0.00792 ETH again.
findings.evidence: fork-logs/07-gas-analysis.txt (per-tx used + limits from `cast tx <hash> gas` on anvil), 07-cutover-broadcast-budgetExact.log (OWNER 7920000000000000 -> 1025437594769664), 06-cutover-broadcast-actualEth.log (preflight refusal at live balance, 0 txs sent), 05-cutover-preview-executable.log (ETH_BUDGET|SHORTFALL 1524805707318410). Verified.
findings.recommendation: Re-derive the budget from the 67-tx session: max over txs of (cumulative gasUsed before the tx + its signed limit) = 25.16M at 0.3 gwei on 25990689. Round up to e.g. 27M, keep the 1.2x factor, and state the assumed staker counts (DOLA 9 / USDC 13 / USDe 7). Better: have preview compute it, by summing simulated gas per recorded tx x 2 (the estimate multiplier) and taking the running max, and print ETH_BUDGET from that figure instead of a constant. Update the '46 transactions' text in the :broadcast comment and the NatSpec.

findings.title: A Phase 6b stall that outlives the minter window freezes every migrated staker: resume reverts in Phase 0 'window EXPIRED' before Phase 7 can unpause V2, and the only exit is re-initiate plus another 6h wait; the runbook documents the re-initiate path but not that V1+V2 stay paused throughout
findings.severityRationale: Availability impact on user funds, but it needs a halt that outlives the 66h+ start window (or a global pause spanning it). Every step is attended and the remedy is documented. It is a runbook-completeness issue with a fork-proven consequence. Rises to Low if L-09(b) or L-10 halts become likely near the end of the window.
findings.description: Phase 0 runs the window preflight on every resume until the minter execute has landed. If the session halts after Phase 6 (all V1 stakers migrated into a V2 that Phase 3 paused) and the halt outlives initiatedAt+78h, every resume reverts in Phase 0. Phase 7, which unpauses V2, is unreachable without a script edit.
findings.impact: Migrated stakers cannot withdraw from V2 for the halt duration plus at least 6h after re-initiation, plus operator latency. DOLA minting stays disabled if the halt was after 6b step (a).
findings.evidence: work/test/audit-run35/CutoverAuditRun35.t.sol::test_R35_OBS04_windowLapseAfterPhase6_resumeBlocked_stakersFrozen PASS on fork 25990689 (fork-logs/16-R35-OBS04-test.log). Sequence: initiate (090 script) -> age 6h -> Phases 0..6 -> age to 78h+1 -> harnessPhase0 reverts exact 'Phase0: minter DOLA withdrawal window EXPIRED - ...' -> V2 DOLA staker withdraw reverts (paused) -> initiate re-runs OK -> Phase 0 reverts again (waiting period). Time moved by ageing initiatedAt, as the sponsor tests do.
findings.recommendation: State the blast radius in the runbook's RE-INITIATE PATH: all V2 stakers stay paused until the re-initiated window opens. Alternatively, let a resume past Phase 6 whose window has lapsed run Phase 7 (unpause/register V2) while leaving Phase 6b pending. V2's DOLA autoAnnihilate would then mint into 0x1760 until 6b runs, so keep DOLA minting disabled (6b step a) in that branch.

relationships.note: consequence of any Phase 6b halt outliving the window; independent root cause (Phase 0 window gate blocks Phase 7 unpause)

findings.title: dola-ys-withdrawal:status prints 'EXECUTABLE - cutover may broadcast now' for the entire [initiatedAt+6h, initiatedAt+78h] window and while the strategy is paused, but the cutover refuses to start in the last 6h (WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN) and its execute is whenNotPaused; story 092's runbook uses this line as the go signal
findings.severityRationale: Fail-safe: the cutover's Phase 0 reverts loudly with guidance. It wastes an operator attempt and may prompt an unnecessary top-up or session prep, but nothing moves.
storyRefs: story-092 runbook step 2 ('dola-ys-withdrawal:status must say EXECUTABLE')
findings.description: The status script's EXECUTABLE branch (`nowTs <= expiresAt`) mirrors the strategy's own window. It does not mirror the cutover's start gate, `block.timestamp + WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN < closesAt`. It also does not qualify EXECUTABLE by `strategy.paused()`.
findings.impact: Operator told 'cutover may broadcast now' when `:preview`/`:broadcast` will refuse.
findings.evidence: Anvil fork 25990689, initiatedAt aged 75h: status 'EXECUTABLE - cutover may broadcast now; seconds until expiry: 10783' (fork-logs/04-status-last6h.log). The cutover :preview on the same state reverts 'Phase0: fewer than WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN seconds left...' (fork-logs/04-cutover-preview-last6h.log). Verified.
findings.recommendation: Split the phase into 'EXECUTABLE, cutover may START (>6h left)' and 'EXECUTABLE but too late to START a cutover (<6h left): wait for expiry, re-initiate'. Print a 'strategy PAUSED - execute will revert' override when paused. Import WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN from a shared constant rather than duplicating it.

findings.title: initiate-dola-ys-withdrawal tells the operator to 'broadcast the cutover between executableAt and expiresAt' (story 090 wording), contradicting story 092's 6h WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN start gate; the printed timestamps are from forge's local pass, not the mined block

storyRefs: story-090 (log instruction AC, read-back AC initiatedAt == block.timestamp)
findings.description: The readback and the printed initiatedAt/executableAt/expiresAt run after `vm.stopBroadcast()` inside forge's local EVM. With `--skip-simulation --ledger` the mined initiatedAt is later by the confirmation latency. The instruction line omits the 6h safety margin that the consumer (cutover Phase 0) enforces. The 'READBACK OK' line therefore asserts a local-pass state.
findings.impact: The operator plans the cutover against an expiry up to 6h (+ signing latency) later than the real start deadline. Fail-safe.
